mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.operator_id, o.operator_name, o.operator_role, o.op_action, o.reason, o.before_json, o.after_json, o.farm_id, o.change_request_id, cr.request_no AS change_request_no, o.created_at FROM t_operation_log o LEFT JOIN t_change_request cr ON cr.id = o.change_request_id WHERE o.operator_type = 'USER' AND o.biz_type = #{bizType} AND o.biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
